# J and B Barista Academy

> Specialty coffee school in Hetauda, Bagmati Province, Nepal. Runs four to eight week barista, latte art and cafe management courses inside a working cafe, with classes capped at eight students and training on the cafe's production equipment.

## Key facts

- Name: J and B Barista Academy (also written J & B Barista Academy)
- Type: specialty coffee school and barista training centre
- Location: Hetauda, Bagmati Province, Nepal
- Class size: eight students maximum
- Graduates: 10,000+ trained since opening
- Contact: 9855018029 (international: +977 9855018029), Jbaristaacademy@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.jandbbaristaacademy.edu.np

## Courses

### Barista Foundation
- Length: 4 weeks
- Level: beginner
- Summary: espresso extraction, milk texturing, and the science behind a balanced shot.
- Outcomes: dial in a grinder and hold a recipe; steam milk to a stable microfoam; run a clean, fast espresso bar.

### Latte Art Mastery
- Length: 6 weeks
- Level: intermediate
- Summary: build a steady pour and a repeatable pattern, from a clean heart to a full rosetta.
- Outcomes: control flow rate and pitcher height; pour hearts, tulips and rosettas; keep symmetry under service pressure.

### Coffee Shop Management
- Length: 8 weeks
- Level: advanced
- Summary: costing, supply, menu design, and the operating rhythm of a small cafe.
- Outcomes: build a menu with real margins; plan stock and supplier terms; write a launch plan you can fund.

## Practical details

- Morning sessions are practical blocks held before cafe service.
- Evening sessions cover cupping and theory for the management track.
- No prior experience is required for Barista Foundation.
- Enrolment and visit enquiries are handled by phone, email, Facebook or Instagram.
